capture_rule: Retain every finite positive-temperature row present in both official NIST-JANAF gas tables for which both formation-Gibbs and log-formation-equilibrium columns are populated; preserve source order, all returned columns, all orientations and every crossing row.
identity_rule: Each target identity is the ordered common-row ordinal plus the held reaction, state, standard-pressure and paired-source identities; no temperature or thermochemical value enters an identity row.
stoichiometric_identity: one N2O4 gas carrier to two NO2 gas carriers
